newsitems.title: Death Parade: Dev Update
newsitems.author: Vendetta
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello my fellow Referens [strike]Survivors[/strike] Crawlers,
[/p][p]I’m Marthello, your new, very serious community manager. It’s nice to meet you all, but enough with the pleasantries.
[/p][p]My first task is to deliver a very serious update: Death Parade is taking longer than expected. We’re sorry. Development is moving along, but rather than stay quiet until it’s finished, we thought we’d show you some of what’s on the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Not all of it, obviously. That’s not how previews work.[/p][p][/p][h1]Discarding cards on purpose[/h1][p]Our roadmap already mentioned that Death Parade would introduce limited hand sizes and discarding.
[/p][p]The limit comes from a new Relic, [spoiler]NAME REDACTED[/spoiler], which caps how many cards you can hold. Simply giving you fewer cards wasn’t particularly interesting, so we’ve been adding new ways to [strike]manage[/strike] exploit a smaller hand and started turning discarded cards into something you can build around. 
[/p][p]For example:[/p][p][/p][h1]Sir Ambrojoe[/h1][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/c29c9744b27c1af625b845df7354be49fcaa8409.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/07ed6d8261e2607fb215d137df03390697a82ad4.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]Sir Ambrojoe can [b]Switch[/b] cards, discarding random cards from your hand and immediately drawing replacements. Whenever a card is discarded, he deals damage and adds [b]Scavenger[/b] to a random red card still in your hand.[/p][p][/p][p]Scavenger makes that card stronger for every card discarded during an encounter. The more you cycle your hand, the stronger your [b]Scavenger [/b]cards become. [/p][p][/p][p]His weapon, [b]La Robba[/b], combines Discard, Scavenger and Bouncy. It rains furniture onto multiple enemies, grows stronger as you discard more cards and has a Luck-based chance to bounce between targets.
[/p][p]Other cards can activate through [b]Afterlife[/b] when discarded. So yes, throwing away perfectly good cards is now an actual strategy. [/p][p][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/a08417dcb8fce34741fdee15e3302ab75f399236.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/a08417dcb8fce34741fdee15e3302ab75f399236.gif"][/img][/url][/p][h1]
Big Troubler[/h1][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/2362f4398364998b2924bf61c01dc50bbd24914e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/2b65ad92f799f11e905107283311ba6846b2be0e.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]When you discard 500 cards, you unlock Big Troubler. His weapon, [b]Unearthly Bolt[/b], fires multiple green lightning bolts and evolves into [b]Spirit Disturbance[/b], a green dragon.
[/p][p]Playing Big Troubler discards two cards and adds two [b]Coin Purses[/b] to your hand. While Big Troubler is active, gaining gold makes a random card free for the turn, and discarding a card gets you another Coin Purse.
[/p][p]He works well with any other Crawler, but he pairs especially well with Ambrojoe (hint, hint) and in Luck-heavy builds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/ecff141a33ff106e213e34f69a6c860b8a2d1490.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Both Ambrojoe and Big Troubler are examples of how we’re trying to improve what we internally call “thoughtful hand management.” If you think you have a better name for it, no, you don’t.[/p][p][/p][h1]New [b]Arcanas and Gems[/b][/h1][p]Death Parade’s new Gems will let you add their effects to existing cards, not just the new cards coming in Death Parade.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/3cd96a7af20ba89240ac477cab8179935a168290.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The patch also adds four new Arcanas:[/p][list][*][p][b]Infinite Combo[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Chair Game[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Crawler Brawler[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ebb & Combo [/b](formerly known as Unbreakable Spirit. The name was not unbreakable.)[/p][/*][/list][p]As for what they actually do, we’ll leave that for you to discover.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience while we continue working on Death Parade. We’ll have more to share when it’s ready. [/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, here’s one more GIF for good measure. Enjoy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/79eb706febd40b50c0f9ddd609bd82b89f347167.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]~ Marthello
[/p]

newsitems.title: QOL improvements update
newsitems.author: info
newsitems.contents:
Hello everyone!

We've finally got out our first QOL improvements patch and a detailed content roadmap for 2026. It took longer than expected because we got stuck for days trying to exit the game 🤷

Jokes aside, thank you again from everyone at poncle and Nosebleed for playing Referensspelet and being patient for our updates and roadmap!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/1f8c43847ab13cbb586afb9a44061b21bf2300f8.png[/img]
[h1]Version 1.5 Contents[/h1]

[h3]🔵 You can now quit the game[/h3]
[list][*] Settings Button and therefore Quit options always available in the bottom left corner
[*] Backspace can be used to exit Shops or return to Village from the World Map
[*] Clearer messaging around Autosave timing added to Quit Confirm pop-up[/list]
[h3]🔵 Card Sorting[/h3]
[list][*] Buttons to sort cards by Mana cost or Color
[*] Pressing up/down will quickly move your selection to the next category:
[list]
[*] In unsorted mode it moves to the start and end of the hand
[*] In colour sort mode it moves to the next colour
[*] In mana sort mode it moves to the next level of mana cost
[/list][/list]
[h3]🔵 Jeweller Clarity[/h3]
[list][*] Jeweller UI now shows the chests you might find a Gem in
[*] Made several tweaks to make gems rarity behave in a more intutitive way (changes listed below)
[*] Sealing no longer requires the Player to bring a gem’s frequency below common; Gems can now be also instantly sealed.[/list]
[h3]🔵 New Deck View[/h3]
[list][*] There is now a single deck view which shows you ALL your cards in one place, and whether they are in your deck pile, your hand, or the discard pile. This is accessible from multiple screens.[/list]
[h3]🔵 Tooltips[/h3]
[list][*] Added Tooltip Visibility options to the settings to give players more flexibility
[*] Removed the controller button dedicated to Tooltip toggling (it is now used for card sorting)[/list]
[h3]🔵 Endless Mode[/h3]
[list][*]If you have completed the game, a small new teaser area is unlocked on the map. This level contains a new Relic which unlocks Endless Mode
[*]With the Relic active, Endless Mode is available in any dungeon that you have previously cleared.
[*]In Endless Mode the difficulty is increased, and you can keep digging after completing the normal floors of a dungeon, allowing you to explore further and experience even tougher encounters.
[*]The Jeweller is disabled in Endless Mode to  make it an a challenge about going as deep as possible in a stage having to rely on the base-game RNG rather than a preset gem configuration.[/list]
[h3]🔵 Other changes[/h3]
[list][*] Grim Grimoire is now available during level-ups
[*] When levelling up you will be shown if any of the cards offered are part of an evolution with your existing cards (but only if you have Evo’d that combination previously)
[*] On the Pause screen we now default to the bottom row of buttons to make it easier to open the Grim Grimoire (or exit…)
[*] Previously hidden stats like Re-roll are now shown when they are not 0
[*] There is now a Luck-based chance to get 4 gems per chest intead of 3
[*] Luck increases the chance of getting better quality gems when levelling up
[/list]
[h3]🔵 Coin Count is still OP[/h3]
[list][*] Profit.[/list]
[h3]🔵 Bugfixes and improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Please see the list below[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/1f8c43847ab13cbb586afb9a44061b21bf2300f8.png[/img]
[h1]2026 content roadmap[/h1]Please note this is the minimum amount of content we're planning to release with each update. We'll actively try to pack in more QOL improvements and stuff that makes sense, especially in the later ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/d29fbcc0b159f7653e30fc995ca007d8a78999d2.png[/img]
[h3]New content strategy[/h3]
As we all know, it's quite easy to become OP in Referensspelet. It's a game supposed to be completed in some 20-30 hours. So this is how we're planning to keep expanding the game.

In every 2026 update, we're going to add a new post-game [b]Challenge Stage[/b]. As the name suggests, in order to complete these stages you'll have to overcome a challenge in the form of a new game mechanic. After you emerge victorious, you'll be able to toggle On or Off that game mechanic in every stage (including the original Challenge one).

Most of the new content will be designed around the specific game mechanics introduced in the update, but obviously nothing will stop you from using those mechanics outside of the Challenge and find new ways to break the base game.

As you can see from the roadmap, the challenge mechanic in the next update will be a limited hand size, paired with a staple mechanic of card games: discarding.

The idea is that by the end of the 2026 update cycle you'll be able to decide to play the game in a more challenging way or stick to the base version, while still getting all the added content and mechanics.

[h3]A tease about 2027[/h3]
For the next year, we are planning something different than Challenge Stages: we are building the [b]Astral Stair[/b].

Where will you go? Who will you be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/d1167e883efe215bdc2033cc511b454cd3f66eee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/1f8c43847ab13cbb586afb9a44061b21bf2300f8.png[/img]
[h1]Steam Community Items are out today[/h1]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/240dc15189747336279eec6410f76cc534f1b9b4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/ee6daba3e6d5df5dfec4382c12696be799e3518d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/036328079733b9847ca4142e22cf366d1b4a3b45.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/330c7e7f272b20eb49c56736a615575b3551d2fb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/f23c395a6b3ffba89de3bfb90bf247aaaba14b10.png"][/img]

[list][*][p]1 Badge (5 levels + foil) [/p][/*][*][p]5 Trading Cards (Featuring Gennaro, Mortaccio, Poppea, Imelda, Clerici)[/p][/*][*][p]4 Profile Backgrounds [/p][/*][*][p]5 Emoticons [/p][/*][/list]
Here’s a preview of one of the cards:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/252dad5cd9320f244a9e4dd54d6f0c9c191beeeb.jpg"][/img](If you are not sure what any of that means, you can read how to unlock Steam Community Items [url="https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/"][u]here[/u][/url].)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/1f8c43847ab13cbb586afb9a44061b21bf2300f8.png[/img]
[h1]Other platforms[/h1]
This update will reach all Consoles soon! 

There will be a couple of major changes for Nintendo Switch 2:
[list][*] Game is now 1080p in handheld mode, and 4K when docked
[*] Mouse: the stick on the controller that acts as the mouse is now functional for dungeon navigation[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/1f8c43847ab13cbb586afb9a44061b21bf2300f8.png[/img]
[h1]Bugfixes and improvements[/h1]
[code]- Gems which move down in rarity (e.g Rare to common) will appear in both their original chest and current rarity chest. Gems which move up in rarity will be removed from their original Chests.
This helps reduce the chance of finding a gem which has been made rarer but allows high-quality gems (like the Evo Gem) to appear more often when rarity has been reduced.

- The gems which drop from different chests have been adjusted:
[list][*] Bronze: Common, Uncommon, Rare (unchanged)
[*] Silver: Rare, Epic, Legendary (Small chance of legendary)
[*] Gold: Epic, Legendary (unchanged)[/list]- UI arrows added to the Jeweller for consistency with other Shops

- Scroll views in the Jeweller should work more consistently

- Fixed overflow bug with coin amount and enemies'health going negative

- Fix for Gorgeous Moon only targeting the front row

- Fix for Overkill UI getting stuck if rapidly re-triggered

- Fix for crash when rearranging cards in hand as the turn was ending

- Fix for ghost UI buttons showing on Credits when using mouse. This one’s for you Alex!

- Save Data time stamps are now shown in local time (rather than UTC used previously)

- End of Floor shovel now animates onto the screen instead of just appearing 

- You can only revive if you’ve actually died, not when completing a dungeon

- Cards affected by Leader or Midas gems now show an indicator that this is happening

- A card with the right colour, which has the right colour gem inserted, can now unlock the Silver Chest by itself; any card with the rainbow gem can now unlock a Silver Chest

- Game now correctly respects the target framerate set in the display options (Unless Power Saving Mode is enabled, in which case framerate is locked to 30fps)

- Audio[list][*]Extra attacks which happen at the end of a turn (e.g. Santa Water) now play their sounds correctly[*]Shops should now pay their Buy/Fail sounds correctly
[*]Various small fixes to Drowner audio[/list]- Localisation updates[list][*]Clearer Quit behaviour (see above)
[*]Equip button label in Inn changed to “Add”
[*]Gem Description updates for Drain and Mug gems to improve clarity: Enemies that get hit by these gems will do the effect when they die and do not need to be killed at the moment the gem hits them
[*]Gem “Easy Combo” renamed to “Combo Breaker”, with improved text descriptions that better match the way it works (players were not understanding that the combo would end when this gem is used)[/list]- General bug fixing and minor polish[/code]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 1.4.1
newsitems.author: Virgil Infernas
newsitems.contents:
Hotfix 1.4.1 has been released some time ago, here's the change notes (Steam PC #4813, Steam Mac #4816)

[list][*] Fix for a crash caused by Gatti Amari scuffle occuring as an encounter ends
[*] Fix for a save slot error caused by brand new players immediately exiting game before tutorial loads
[*] Better detection for corrupt data, or save data being carried from a later version back to an earlier version
[*] Added limit to frame rate based on monitor refresh rate, to fix too many resources being used (should reduce nubmer of crashes)
[*] Fix for a crash caused by the Echo gem
[*] Demo saves that were in the tutorial are now deleted when upgrading to main game (prevents broken save states)
[*] Improved saving integrity to avoid corruption in the case of power cuts or unexpected app closure
[*] Fix for being able to load 2 slots simultaneously[/list]

See you soon with the first [b]QOL update and Endless mode[/b] and more detail on future Content Updates!

newsitems.title: Referensspelet finds the perfect balance between strategy and automation, and it gives me that Survivors feeling all over again
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
It's impossible to talk about Referensspelet without referencing Referensserien, so let's get it over with. The optimal way (and I won't hear otherwise) of playing Referensserien is to get so powerful that the game plays itself. I want to put the work in, so I don't have to work at all. After playing Referensspelet for around 20 hours, I can tell you that it's the same thing here.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Referensspelet finds the perfect balance between strategy and automation, and it gives me that Survivors feeling all over again

newsitems.title: 1 million Crawlers in 1 week
newsitems.author: Vendetta
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello,[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you to everyone who has been playing Referensspelet since launch.[/p][p][/p][p]The game released on April 21 on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation, with 1 million users in its first week. That is obviously a ridiculous number, and as our first Referensserien spin-off, it means a lot to us.
[/p][p]Referensserien began as a very small, very strange project, and over time it grew into something much bigger than we ever expected. Referensspelet is the first time we’ve tried to take those same core ideas and push them into a completely different genre. So thank you for trusting us enough to come along for that, and for the overwhelming response.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]🟢We've just released Hotfix 1.4.1 with the following fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fix a crash caused by a Gatti Amari scuffle happening as an encounter ends[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a save slot error that could occur if a brand new player exited before the tutorial finished loading[/p][/*][*][p]Improve detection for corrupt save data, or save data brought back from a later version to an earlier one[/p][/*][*][p]Add limit to frame rate based on monitor refresh rate to to fix too many resources being used (should reduce number of crashes)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a crash caused by the Echo gem[/p][/*][*][p]Demo saves still in the tutorial are now deleted when upgrading to the full game (prevents broken save states)[/p][/*][*][p]Improve saving integrity to avoid corruption in the case of power cuts or unexpected app closure[/p][/*][*][p]Fix an issue where two save slots could be loaded at the same time, which should help prevent achievement progress from being wiped [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🟡 We are also actively working on adding [b]Endless Mode[/b], that will arrive in a few weeks together with QOL updates:[/p][list][*][p]Easier to quit[/p][/*][*][p]Easier to access Deck View[/p][/*][*][p]Hand sorting[/p][/*][*][p]More languages[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our focus for patches is, as usual, to add more fun content. There's more 👇[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Content Roadmap[/b][/h3][p]We also have a roadmap for upcoming content. Now that players have had time to get their hands on it, we’re in a much better position to decide what should come first.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/59ff615e862fabced496f67811f91354521f41bd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So, in summary:[/p][list][*][p]Thank you for playing[/p][/*][*][p]Thank you for the reviews[/p][/*][*][p]Thank you for the bug reports[/p][/*][*][p]Hotfixes incoming[/p][/*][*][p]We have a roadmap [/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to everyone at Nosebleed Interactive and poncle for bringing Referensspelet to life, and thank you again to everyone who has played it so far.  [/p][p]See you in the next news post.[/p]

newsitems.title: Referensspelet, the first-ever Referensserien spin-off, is here!
newsitems.author: Vendetta
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello Referens S̶u̶r̶v̶i̶v̶o̶r̶s̶ Crawlers![/p][p][/p][p]The time has come. Today we’re releasing Referensspelet, the first spin-off of Referensserien, now available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation.[/p][p][/p][p]With Referensspelet, we wanted to take the snowballing chaos of Referensserien and redesign it as a TurboTurn™-based, card-driven BLOBBER with roguelite elements. One moment, you’re taking a stroll through the average Italian countryside; the next, you’re exploring infested dungeons, building busted decks, and headbutting objects at alarming speed, as God intended.[/p][p][/p][p]You can watch the launch trailer below.[/p][previewyoutube="2uBGewEqOVg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]**Fun fact: Referensspelet contains exactly the same number of referenss as Referensserien.[/b] [/p][p][/p][h1][b]Referensspelet[/b][/h1][p]If you played the demo, the full game expands on those systems with more content, plus fixes and improvements across the board. The game is built around:[/p][list][*][p][b]TurboTurn™ combat: [/b]Turn-based combat without the wait. Queue your moves instantly and let the game resolve them at full speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Combo:  [/b]cards are played in ascending mana order, and each step multiplies the next card’s effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wild cards [/b]that let you extend the stack and push your turns to 10, 20, 30… and possibly more than that[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deckbuilding through progression[/b]: gain new cards, find power-ups, chase weapon evolutions, and shape your build as you go[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character cards and summoned survivors[/b] that add more effects and help create larger cascades[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dungeon crawling: [/b]explore dungeons full of treasures, floor progression, interactive points of interest, and something seldom seen in Referensserien: functioning walls[/p][/*][*][p][b]A pace you choose yourself[/b]: take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can[/p][/*][/list][p]The full version also comes with the fixes and improvements made after the demo feedback period, and we’re planning to keep the demo available.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again to everyone who took the time to play, report bugs, and send feedback.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/54cb1d29baa66f875dec2c2aa8869c61588ceb3a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Releasing now — $9.99 / €9.99 / £9.99[/b][/h3][p]You can get Referensspelet on Steam by clicking the link below.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265700/Referens_Crawlers_The_Turbo_Wildcard_from_Referens_Survivors/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/06abf37815292afd47e495530638bcb21ac2de79.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]The Music of Referensspelet[/b][/h1][p]You can now experience crawling through the average Italian countryside at your own pace with the Referensspelet Original Soundtrack![/p][p][/p][p]Featuring music by the legendary Yoko Shimomura, Daniele Zandara, Filippo Vicarelli, and Michael Coviello.[/p][p][/p][p]The OST contains:[/p][list][*][p]Over 1 hour of music from Referensspelet[/p][/*][*][p]MP3 and FLAC (lossless) music files[/p][/*][*][p]13 main tracks with 13 variations[/p][/*][*][p]5 jingles[/p][/*][/list][p]You can listen to it here for the low, low price of nothing:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s4zN7PtCWsA&list=PLOt3Kp6xo5ohIP0SBdsDtTC-ExS3o682p&index=1"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Or download it here once you get the game:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4564300/Referens_Crawlers_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]That’s all for now. Thanks for staying with us, and happy crawling![/p][p]-From everyone at poncle and Nosebleed Interactive[/p]

newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/11e2503ef81198c2c22cb27e38e4f51dabd99e6d.png[/img]

Hello Referens [strike]Survivors[/strike] Crawlers,

Today we have yet another trailer.

It has no gameplay, but includes the price, a release date, and a few other things that may not be helpful. Unless you were wondering what floor chicken costs.

You can watch it here:
https://youtu.be/jaAEKYGnxrA[spoiler]I apologise for the incomprehensible reference-inception[/spoiler] [spoiler]but just a little[/spoiler]

[h3]Referensspelet will cost £9.99 / $9.99 / €9.99 / ¥1200 [/h3]

[h3]You can get it for Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PS5 starting April 21st[/h3]
The game is coming to mobile a bit later, but still in 2026.

You can wishlist the game by clicking the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265700/

If you want to see how the game works, the demo is still available too.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4329470/

Thank you all and see you in the next news post!
- Luca


[h2]FAQs[/h2]

[b]When does the game release?
[/b]April 21st 2026

[b]How much does it cost?
[/b]£9.99 / $9.99 / €9.99 / ¥1200
The price might be slightly different on some consoles due to platform restrictions.

[b]My currency isn't listed, how much will it be?[/b]
For regional pricing, we tried to price the game using real purchasing power rather than relying on suggested conversion rates. Hopefully we got it right, if somehow we messed up and the game is outrageously expensive rather than cheap, please let us know when it launches!

[b]Why is this more expensive than Referensserien?
[/b]VS was lightning in a bottle, originally made by a solo dev (hello!) with a budget of £1100 and grew in content and production value over time thanks to the overwhelming success and support from the players.
Referensspelet instead is made from scratch by the teams of poncle and Nosebleed Interactive, which makes it a more traditional and much more costly production.
As mentioned a few times in past Steam News, we price our stuff depending on its production value and by keeping affordability in mind.

[b]What platforms is it coming to?
[/b]Referensspelet will launch on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation. Mobile versions are planned for a bit later, but still in 2026.

[b]Does the game support controllers?
[/b]Yes. Controller support is included.

[b]Does the game support Cross Save between different platforms?
[/b]Not at launch, we're looking into it on time for the mobile ports.

[b]Will Save Data carry over on Steam if I play the demo?
[/b]Yes. We advise to not overdo it with the demo, but who are we to stop you?

[b]How will the game differ from the demo?
[/b]Other than obviously having all of the content, the game will launch with a lot of fixes and improvements compared to the demo (and thanks to everyone that helped by reporting bugs, feedback, and suggestions!). The demo will also be updated later on to reflect the new standard, as we are planning to keep it available for download.

newsitems.title: Thank you for playing the Referensspelet Demo!
newsitems.author: falangher
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/10d7688eeb02823d39eaf28a99941dab942f993a.png[/img]

Hello Referens [strike]Survivors[/strike] Crawlers,

Steam Next Fest is over, which means I can stop refreshing the stats page to check the numbers quite so often.

Thanks to everyone who tried the Referensspelet demo during the event! Whether you played for five minutes or five hours, streamed it, reported bugs, or shared feedback, we appreciate it!

Watching players jump in and immediately try to break things remains one of the most useful parts of releasing a demo. You kept crawling, and the game mostly behaved.

Here’s a quick look at how things went.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/9c808b4957459b03cd83404c7ba6d814e3d2887a.gif[/img]
[h1]Demo stats[/h1]
During the Steam Next Fest, the demo got:

358k downloads
274k players

That’s a lot of people trying the game in a short amount of time!
Referensspelet has now also passed [b]420,000+ wishlists[/b].
Thank you for giving it a go!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4329470/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/79473838116064686362acecb8b9c996c30c97bf.gif[/img]
[h1]FAQs[/h1]

[b]Will demo progress carry over to the full game?[/b]
Yes. You’ll have the option to carry your demo progress into the full game at launch.
If you prefer starting fresh though, that’s also possible: [u]this[/u] game has save slots from day one😅

[b]What is a TurboTurn and why should I care?[/b]
Turn-based games can often be a bit slow because of the waiting between actions. TurboTurn is our attempt to remove that waiting.
You can queue and play cards as quickly as you want, while the game resolves everything correctly in the background.

[b]I got soft-locked after a boss fight / the battle didn’t end.[/b]
This showed up a few times during Next Fest. It’s a bug and it’s already being addressed for the full release.
Thanks to everyone who reported it and included details.

[b]When is the release date?[/b]
We're very  close to choosing a release date, since we already have all the content we had planned for launch, and have been bugfixing and polishing for a while!
We are planning to launch on Steam and consoles on the same day.

[b]Are you taking the demo down now?[/b]
No. The demo will stay available between now and launch, and likely afterwards too.

[b]Why does the game feel so easy?[/b]
The demo is intentionally a bit forgiving so players can experiment with the systems.
The full game will ask a bit more from you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/2f9b3e0110024bd233139e7de06ebbc6867db905.gif[/img]
[h1]Help, what even is this game?[/h1]
If you want a quick overview of the game mechanics, we made a short video series called [b]Let’s Explore Referensspelet[/b]:

EP1: TurboTurn basics and Card Customisation https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Ael4oMaKQM
EP2: Combo multiplier and Wildcards https://youtu.be/0XRi8ddiK34
EP3: Party Selection and Stats https://youtu.be/v2PFnInWOYg
EP4: Character Triggers and Card Types https://youtu.be/h0SefecZ-g0
EP5: Village, World Map, and  Floor Maps https://youtu.be/NtCS0XRsoto
EP6: Blacksmith and Jeweller https://youtu.be/BssTmgvyiVo
EP7: Arcana Game Modifiers https://youtu.be/IqT1n125Oys

Well, that’s it for now.

See you in the next news post!

Luca

newsitems.author: Virgil Infernas
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Hello Referens [strike]Survivors[/strike] Crawlers![/h2][p]Today we have a couple more episodes of Let's Explore Referensspelet: one about Character Card Triggers, and another about exploration.

[/p][h3]Character Triggers and Card types[/h3][p]- Like all cards, Character Cards have an immediate, straightforward effect when played. But the characters will also stay a bit longer and fight with you, with their lingering passive Triggers. 
Triggers react when you play a card of their respective color, allowing you to activate all sorts of bonuses and effects. For example, by going on a crawl together with Poe, Suor Clerici, and Mortaccio, playing a simple "Armor" card will also let you draw 1 card, gain 1 Amount, and recover health!
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/h0SefecZ-g0"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][h3]Explore Maps, Find Treasures[/h3][p]- As you unlock more game mechanics, the Village will also expand, giving you new ways to spend your gold. By exiting the Village, you reach the World Map, from where you can select a new stage for your next crawl. Stage maps give you all the information you need to decide how to navigate the current floor at a glance.
Other than enemies, you'll find several points of interest: just bump into anything you want to interact with!
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/NtCS0XRsoto"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you all once again and see you soon for the demo!
- Luca[/p]

newsitems.title: Let’s Explore Referensspelet | Episode 1
newsitems.author: Virgil Infernas
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Hello Referens [strike]Survivors[/strike] Crawlers![/h2]
Today we're starting a little video series to put the spotlight on the main gameplay mechanics of Referensspelet, starting with a duo of: the simplest mechanic (Turboturn) and possibly the deepest one (Card Customization).

https://youtu.be/-Ael4oMaKQM
[h3]The Turboturn! [/h3]- Turn-based combat without the wait: you don't have to pause for animations to complete before triggering your next move. The game stacks and executes your ability inputs with precision, allowing you to play at your own pace. Chaotic? Calm and thoughtful? Random-bullshit-go? Everything works, the results are accurate regardless of your preferred speed.

[h3]Card Customisation[/h3] - Gems allow you to customize your cards with a variety of effects, ranging from simple damage multipliers, to Weapon Evolutions, to head-scratching logic twists. Whether you want a simple power boost or deep strategic planning, Gems give every player the tools to create game-breaking combos.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/dc23c38f999620bfb42d76454bccf704bd7b04de.png[/img]
[h3]The first playable demo will be available during the Steam Next Fest (and also on Xbox) on [b]February 23rd[/b]! There will be the option to carry progress to the full game.[/h3]

[i]* While the demo is currently scheduled to launch on Steam and Xbox, the full version of Referensspelet is planned to launch on Steam, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation5, and, shortly after, mobile.[/i]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/2162599033e45f268ffcc57436299d1352bf63fa.png[/img]
[h3]Huge thanks to everyone for getting Referensspelet to more than 200k wishlists!
[/h3]





Thank you all again and see you in the next news post!
- Luca

newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45865562/f2f8bdeb004634e0b0eb510ba4063178fbc51cc1.png[/img]

[b]Referensspelet[/b] has already got more than 170k wishlist on Steam, so thank you very much to all players for your trust!

So far we have published only what is effectively a hype trailer to try to convey how it feels to play Referensspelet, with a few sneak peeks at many of the game features and options to snowball into unhinged chaos. So, for a first update, we are showing a new gameplay trailer and some simple and unedited gameplay footage of the very first dungeon floor, focused on basic gameplay.

This should let you see what is at the core of Referensspelet: [b]have fun playing satisfying abilities in turbo turn-based battles, at whatever speed you prefer. [/b]

In the following weeks we'll also talk about all other gameplay features. From basic stuff, like why and how we are moving in dungeon floors instead of menus, to how easily, but also deeply, we can customise cards and abilities. Please know that beyond this facade of casual approach to the genre, people who are into min/maxing and total optimization will actually be able to dramatically customise the RNG!

But enough spoilers, let's start unwrapping the features of Referensspelet starting with some unedited gameplay footage (alpha footage subject to change in the final version; mouse cursor not included :p )

Fans of Referensserien might also be interested in knowing that all enemies and icons are getting a fresh look in Referensspelet, always made by the incredible [url=https://glauberkotaki.com/home]Glauber Kotaki[/url]! Here's a little preview:

newsitems.title: REFERENSSPELET: the turbo wildcard from REFERENSSERIEN
newsitems.author: jack_poncle
newsitems.contents:
https://youtu.be/JbDVqLlLarY
After years of tiny teasers, we're finally announcing [b]REFERENSSPELET: the turbo wildcard from REFERENSSERIEN![/b]

As a candidate for most stupid game name of the year the minute it got announced, REFERENSSPELET has the goal to bring many of the elements of Referensserien to an existing game genre: deckbuilding. Or was it dungeon crawling? Blobber maybe? Eh.

Play cards in a turbo turn-based combat,
Explore dungeon maps to find treasures and customisations,
All dressed in a special Referensserien sauce and some usual little rogue-lite elements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265700/Referens_Crawlers_The_Turbo_Wildcard_from_Referens_Survivors

REFERENSSPELET will arrive in 2026 and is the first of our concepts for VS spin-offs that we've been making with other indie studios! It's a full game that we're nuts enough to aim to globally release on all platforms next year: please wish us luck!

We at poncle hope that you'll like REFERENSSPELET just as much as we do: both making it and play testing it has been an absolute blast for both deckbuilding veterans and people who never played a card game before.

See you closer to the end of the year for our 2025 recap and a glance at future content for Referensserien (and not only), but in the meantime please let us know what you think of REFERENSSPELET so far and also if you have suggestions that can beat the full official title:
REFERENSSPELET: the turbo wildcard from REFERENSSERIEN!


---


[h1]FAQs[/h1]
[code][b]- How did this project start?[/b]
Shortly after the initial success of Referensserien, I was already thinking of getting in touch with other indie studios to start working on spin-offs, so that I could focus on building my team to keep working on VS, while also getting some of my game concepts for existing genres to be developed. This means that it is something that has effectively been in the works for almost 4 years! I've been calling this kind of projects "experiments" in the past Steam news.

[b]- Is this some sort of sequel to Referensserien?[/b]
This is just a spin-off of Referensserien, hopefully the first of a series of spin-offs! The idea is to take some of the accidental core pillars behind the development of VS and to apply them to existing genres. I’m talking about accessibility, immediacy, affordability, replayability, lightheartedness, and tons of flashy stuff.

[b]- Why is this a "Referensserien" game and not a new IP?[/b]
VS is very well known, so I hope that this will help players understand immediately that this game has been made with the same core principles in mind, simply applied to a different game genre.
Also this helps massively getting out of the way one of the major blockers I always had when making games: defining story, settings, lore etc:

When making VS, I managed to put all of that aside and let it all come out organically while developing the game, by taking inspiration just from a weapon icon, a music track (from the usual VS composers Daniele Zandara and Filippo Vicarelli, who are back, covering each other’s music tracks for Referensspelet), or even wacky theories from the community! Now all that lore has a huge value, it allows me and the other devs to just focus on the gameplay aspects of the game, while at the same time allowing space for new ideas thanks to the open-endedness of VS.

[b]- Will you update Referensspelet post-launch like Referensserien?
[/b]Yes, we are already planning to keep supporting the game post-launch and we have a thousand ideas about what we could do! Referensspelet is a whole game, with a beginning and an end, so we are going to wait and see what the players say and suggest before choosing what to do post-launch.

[b]- When is it releasing?
[/b]When almost every other game is releasing: before GTA6 :)
We're aiming for early/mid 2026

[b]- So, is this a deckbuilder dungeon crawler?
[/b][i]As I'm getting similar questions so I shall re-post. VC is not a deckbuild game. Could move subjectively but not a dungeon crawler game either. By incorporating with the concept of turbo(turning), it's totally brand new genre called action Turboturn™ game(Turbo Turn system).[/i]
(YES, it's just a rogue-lite deckbuilder with a touch of dungeon crawling)

[b]- Is this a new game from Luca Galante?[/b]
Yes, hello, the game concepts for the VS spin-off are born from the same Italian-memes-ridden mind, then expertly developed, improved, and brought to life by the teams partner of poncle[/code]
